tagline: Cultivating vibrant, highly amenitized, walkable neighborhoods through mixed-use development
hero_kpi_rationale: Primary driver of long-term value creation through the urban transformation of National Landing, the strategic core of the portfolio.

kpis.name: Development Pipeline
kpis.explanation: Total area available for future real estate projects.
kpis.description: The pipeline represents 4.9 million square feet of potential development density, of which 3.6 million is attributable to JBGS. It excludes non-developable parcels or those under option.
kpis.signal: High potential for organic growth in National Landing

kpis.name: Multifamily Units
kpis.explanation: Total number of apartments in the operating portfolio.
kpis.description: 15 multifamily assets totaling 6,519 units, of which 6,333 units are attributable to JBGS.
kpis.signal: Significant residential portfolio in a dense urban area

kpis.name: Commercial SF
kpis.explanation: Total square footage of operating commercial assets.
kpis.description: 22 commercial assets totaling 7.3 million square feet, of which 6.9 million is attributable to JBGS.
kpis.signal: Substantial office portfolio despite remote work pressures

kpis.name: Occupancy Rate - Multifamily
kpis.explanation: Percentage of occupied apartments in comparable multifamily assets.
kpis.description: The same-store multifamily occupancy rate declined from 94.8% at end-2024 to 90.4% at end-2025, driven in part by job losses in the district.
kpis.signal: Deterioration in residential demand in the DC region following job losses

kpis.name: Effective Rent Change - Renewal
kpis.explanation: Average change in rents upon renewal of multifamily leases.
kpis.description: In 2025, effective rents increased by 5.0% on renewals, compared to a 1.1% decline on new leases. The renewal rate was 56.2%.
kpis.signal: Ability to raise rents on loyal tenants, contrasting with 1.1% decline on new leases

kpis.name: Gross Asset Sales Proceeds
kpis.explanation: Total gross proceeds from the sale of real estate assets.
kpis.description: In 2025, JBGS sold three multifamily assets and two development parcels for $554 million in gross proceeds, plus the sale of a 40% interest in a multifamily asset for an additional $100 million.
kpis.signal: Active asset recycling strategy in multifamily to fund opportunistic acquisitions

kpis.name: Acquisitions
kpis.explanation: Total amount invested in new real estate assets (JBGS share).
kpis.description: In 2025, JBGS acquired Tysons Dulles Plaza for $42.3 million and took a 60% stake in Dulles View for $18.9 million, totaling $61.2 million attributable to JBGS.
kpis.signal: Capitalizing on distressed office real estate acquisitions for value opportunities

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.description: Revenue sourced from SEC EDGAR companyfacts XBRL over the last eight reported fiscal years (10-K).
kpis.signal: Revenue of $0.499 billion in the latest fiscal year (FY2025).

kpis.name: Occupancy Rate - Multifamily
kpis.explanation: Percentage of occupied apartments in comparable multifamily assets.
kpis.description: The same-store multifamily occupancy rate declined from 94.8% at end-2024 to 90.4% at end-2025, driven in part by job losses in the district.
kpis.signal: Deterioration in residential demand in the DC region following job losses

kpis.name: Effective Rent Change - Renewal
kpis.explanation: Average change in rents upon renewal of multifamily leases.
kpis.description: In 2025, effective rents increased by 5.0% on renewals, compared to a 1.1% decline on new leases. The renewal rate was 56.2%.
kpis.signal: Ability to raise rents on loyal tenants, contrasting with 1.1% decline on new leases

risks.title: Office Demand Decline
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to declining office demand due to the persistent trend of remote work and corporate downsizing of leased space. Offices represent a significant portion of the portfolio. Office occupancy declined to 75.1% in 2025.

risks.title: Geographic Concentration
risks.score_rationale: The company is heavily concentrated in the Washington D.C. region, making it vulnerable to the economic and political conditions of this area.

ai_positioning.summary: The company has not mentioned artificial intelligence, machine learning, or similar technologies in its filed documents. Its core business appears to be focused on real estate.
